statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "unknown"'); effort=$(jq -r '.effortLevel // ""' /home/465887/.claude/settings.json 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$effort" ] && effort="[effort:$effort]" || effort=""; used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); [ -n "$used" ] && used="ctx:$(printf "%.0f" "$used")%%" || used=""; h=$(hostname); h=${h#*_}; h=${h%%-*}; [ -z "$h" ] && h=$(grep -oP '(?<=^PRETTY_NAME=).*' /etc/os-release | tr -d '"'); [ -z "$h" ] && h=unknown; d=$(pwd | sed "s|^$HOME|~|"); branch=$(git -c core.hookspath=/dev/null symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git -c core.hookspath=/dev/null rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); printf '\033[0;35m[%s]\033[0m \033[1;33m%s\033[0m %s %s@%s \033[1;34m%s\033[0m %s %s' "$(date +%T)" "$model" "$effort" "$h" "$(whoami)" "$d" "${branch:+($branch)}" "$used"
